verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a broad catalog of open-source models (100+ serverless models, dedicated deployment of models like gemma-4) and a model lifecycle policy that mentions 'introducing new models'. None of it documents how quickly newly released open-weight models reach the platform, such as day-zero availability or launch-timing commitments. A broad catalog and a lifecycle policy are adjacent evidence and do not show fast onboarding of new releases.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
